long_description:
Celebrate Diwali with Indy Bollywood Diwali Night – Lights, Beats, and Celebration 🎉

Join us for an evening of Bollywood music, dance, and shared movement. Whether you’re a seasoned dancer or stepping onto the floor for the first time, you’re welcome here. This festive Diwali evening with include a Bollywood workshop, performances, and open dancing - bringing our community together through culture and celebration. Mumma's Magic will be onsite with Samosas, Pakoras, Chai, and mango juice for sale. 

Doors at 6:15PM

Workshop at 6:30PM

Performances at 7:15PM

Open Dancing at 8:00PM

Evening Concludes at 9:00PM

This Diwali celebration is brought to you by Indy Bollywood and Indianapolis Movement Arts Collective. 

Also check out other Workshops in Indianapolis, Arts events in Indianapolis.
